name: HATE staking catch-up rebases captured by a flash stake
summary: HATEStaking.rebase advances a lagging epoch clock by only one epoch per call and distributes the contract's surplus HATE to sHATE holders pro rata, while stake and unstake trigger it with no warmup. With the clock 84 days behind, the attacker flash-swapped 907,615 HATE, cycled stake/unstake three times so six rebases paid most of each distribution to its momentary sHATE, and sold the extra HATE into the HATE/WETH pair; MEV bots and others repeated it over the next month.
notes: The anchor is the first transaction that staked and unstaked in one call; 112 later such transactions exist to 2025, and only the nine listed drew HATE out of the staking contract, the rest found no pending epochs to capture.

HATE has no DefiLlama price; the staking contract's 1,817,314.5 HATE net outflow is valued at the 9.377 WETH the exploiters drew from the HATE/WETH pair selling it (rule 12). setDistributor (block 17297581) only adds minted rewards to the surplus and does not reset (rule 8).
